quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the cultural significance of the Big Baller Brand
quotes.excerpt: I don't think people think about the brand, I don't think they understand the cultural significance.
quotes.quote: I don't think when people think about the brand, I don't think they understand the cultural significance of what this really means. I don't think they'll really pick up on it until much later. Some people won't, some people are, they do understand it. I would tell people this too is, for instance, if you're in LA, if you're in California, or if you come to LA, get down to the store. Walk through here. quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the importance of family-led business structures
quotes.excerpt: If you got a family, don't that one person don't need to be the only guy.
quotes.quote: At this stage in your life, you could have packed it in. You could have stayed up there at the big house, been playing around, doing whatever. You're here with the people, shaking hands, hearing their stories, telling your stories. People are telling you every day the joy that your kids brought them. And I don't, listen, I think that's the most, one of the most unique stories in sports. That's a documentary in itself. The formula is, if you got a family, don't that one person don't need to be the only guy or the only girl. Do it as a family, stick together as a family, and it will work itself out. Will it be easy? No, it'll work itself out.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on building a closer relationship with his son
quotes.excerpt: I got to see a lot of things up close that made me a more present dad.
quotes.quote: My son was with me last time when I was down here, my namesake, Tony, and you got to spend time with him. And I'll tell you this, our relationship that we built, and he would tell you this, is I got to see a lot of things up close that made me a more present dad, to be honest with you. So that part I thank you and love you for is because there was a lot of things that I didn't see in my own life that through things that you were dealing with and everything else, I was able to go to my son and say, hey. You know what I mean? And it worked out.

quotes.quote: There's not an offer that y'all can give me that will make me stop doing what we're doing, because again, my soul's not for sale.
